text: oh and one more thing, this tool + pretty much all the other painting tools in the map editor all need to be instrumented with the proper undo/redo histories. i find i paint some terrain, dont like it, ctrl z and a building disappears lol

events.text: Root contract: Map Paint owns a bounded native gesture history over its RMAP concern. Terrain, water, tile, flora, zone, binding, chunk, road, rail, and TC-stop mutations checkpoint at their real native boundary; Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Shift+Z and the dock route to that journal whenever Map Paint is armed, so building history cannot be consumed by a paint undo.

resolution: Map Paint now owns a bounded native RMAP gesture journal covering terrain, water, tiles, flora, zones, structural map edits, roads, rails, and TC Stops. Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, and dock buttons route to it whenever Map Paint is armed, so paint undo no longer consumes building history; restores recompile roads, dirty native mirrors, autosave, and mirror tile bindings back to chrome. Zig undo/redo restoration tests and the ReleaseFast editor build pass; user interaction and 60-second frame-time review remain.
